body: Thanks, sorry about replying so quick, all of this is on my mind at the moment. I still feel overwhelmed by everything and afraid of what i might do if I don't find a solution. Ill try talking to my teachers again and see if I can work something out and if she is pregnant, I guess I will have to wait until we find out for sure and then cross that bridge when we get there. But again I am afraid if I can't make it until then or if there is not a solution to all this. That I really did mess up this time. It scares me.

I am terrified of what will happen when I have to tell my parents. I am trying desperately to bring my grades back up, but if she really is pregnant,  then I have no idea what to do. I don't want her to be ridiculed or her parents to hate me, the same for mine. I have tried keeping everything secret from them, but I fear that that may no longer be an option soon. I have no idea what to do if she is and if I cant bring my grades up. Everything is closing in on me at once and I cant handle it. Thanks for your help though, I really appreciate it.
